qa_pairs.instruction: What new web service protocol support does the Oracle EBS Suite driver provide in version 4.1?
qa_pairs.output: In version 4.1, the Oracle EBS Suite driver adds support for REST APIs in addition to the existing SOAP support, allowing both REST and SOAP calls when configuring the driver object.

qa_pairs.instruction: How can you configure the Oracle EBS Suite driver to use both REST and SOAP protocols?
qa_pairs.output: When configuring the driver object for the Oracle EBS Suite driver, you can enable both REST and SOAP protocols because the driver now supports REST APIs alongside SOAP.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the new features introduced in version 4.1 of the Oracle EBS Suite driver.
qa_pairs.output: Version 4.1 of the Oracle EBS Suite driver introduces support for REST web services, allowing the driver to work with REST APIs as well as the previously supported SOAP services during driver configuration.
